body: Commit f2c94e4 on main. Per-hero Flow (gold) and XP currencies, separate from resources[]'s win-condition meter. Flow/XP earned from jungle/lane creep and hero kills (melee/homing-shot only). 24-item catalog across 11 FFXI+WoW equip slots with buy/sell/auto-equip and stat application. Economy state and equipped items survive respawn. 13 new tests, 546/546 passing. Sprint 3 (wire protocol) and Sprint 4 (client UI) next.
title: Flow/XP economy + FFXI/WoW item slots, Sprint 1+2 (S170-175)
